purpose: Exploratory third-seed paired comparison; seed selected after results from seeds 42 and 43 were known
training: 600 updates per task; GSPO and CPO use matching data, task order, direct-answer prompt, sampling and evaluation
cpo: Shared first-stage GSPO checkpoint; cumulative per-tensor top 10 percent movement mask and masked L1 with lambda 100 for later tasks
scoring: Normalized exact match against the last boxed answer, or complete response if no box
initial_evaluation: Reused from identical base model and evaluator
preflight: GSPO two-step preflight counted in its original time and storage budget; CPO shares completed first-stage model
budget: Separate run guards: GSPO 38 billion bytes including shared data accounting, CPO 40 billion bytes for output; each below 24 hours from first start
limitations: Patient/study and near-duplicate separation unverified; output format drift; third seed selected after prior results were observed
selection: No test-set tuning or seed selection based on seed 44 performance
